string-array.name: habla_se_entrar_sargento
string-array.item: {nombre}, {minutos} minutes. Begin.

string-array.name: habla_se_entrar_cheerleader
string-array.item: Here we go, {nombre}! I\'m right here with you.

string-array.name: habla_se_entrar_neutra
string-array.item: I\'m here, {nombre}. Go ahead.

string-array.name: habla_de_habito_sargento
string-array.item: Still left today: {habito}. Use the break.

string-array.name: habla_de_habito_cheerleader
string-array.item: Still left today: {habito}. Shall we do it now, during the break?

string-array.name: habla_de_habito_neutra
string-array.item: Still left today: {habito}. Shall we do it now, during the break?

string-array.name: habla_de_habito_largo_sargento
string-array.item: Still left today: {habito}. There are {minutos} minutes ahead.

string-array.name: habla_de_habito_largo_cheerleader
string-array.item: Still left today: {habito}. There are {minutos} min ahead, plenty!

string-array.name: habla_de_habito_largo_neutra
string-array.item: Still left today: {habito}. There are {minutos} min ahead.

string-array.name: habla_de_sin_pendientes_sargento
string-array.item: Everything watered today. Stand up, stretch your legs and drink water.

string-array.name: habla_de_sin_pendientes_cheerleader
string-array.item: Everything\'s watered for today. Get up, stretch your legs and drink some water!

string-array.name: habla_de_sin_pendientes_neutra
string-array.item: Everything\'s watered for today. Get up, stretch your legs and drink some water.

string-array.name: habla_se_hecha_tarea_sargento
string-array.item: Done, {nombre}.

string-array.name: habla_se_hecha_tarea_cheerleader
string-array.item: Done, {nombre}!

string-array.name: habla_se_hecha_tarea_neutra
string-array.item: Done, {nombre}.

string-array.name: habla_se_hecha_habito_sargento
string-array.item: Done, {nombre}.

string-array.name: habla_se_hecha_habito_cheerleader
string-array.item: Done, {nombre}!

string-array.name: habla_se_hecha_habito_neutra
string-array.item: Done, {nombre}.

string-array.name: habla_ce_mejor_sargento
string-array.item: Good. That was the idea.

string-array.name: habla_ce_mejor_cheerleader
string-array.item: So glad to hear it! I\'m here whenever you want.

string-array.name: habla_ce_mejor_neutra
string-array.item: Glad to hear it. I\'m here whenever you want.

string-array.name: habla_ce_igual_sargento
string-array.item: Okay. Sometimes it takes another round.

string-array.name: habla_ce_igual_cheerleader
string-array.item: Okay. Sometimes it takes another round, and I\'m here.

string-array.name: habla_ce_igual_neutra
string-array.item: Okay. Sometimes it takes another round.

string-array.name: habla_ce_cuesta_sargento
string-array.item: Understood. Again, slower. Sleep is the longest rhythm.

string-array.name: habla_ce_cuesta_cheerleader
string-array.item: No rush. Again, more slowly? Sleep is the longest rhythm, and I\'m with you.

string-array.name: habla_ce_cuesta_neutra
string-array.item: No rush. Again, more slowly? Sleep is the longest rhythm.

string-array.name: habla_re_fin_respirar_sargento
string-array.item: Done, {nombre}.

string-array.name: habla_re_fin_respirar_cheerleader
string-array.item: That\'s it, {nombre}! That felt good.

string-array.name: habla_re_fin_respirar_neutra
string-array.item: There, {nombre}.

string-array.name: habla_re_respirar_mejor_sargento
string-array.item: Yesterday breathing did you good. “{modo}” is still here.

string-array.name: habla_re_respirar_mejor_cheerleader
string-array.item: Yesterday breathing did you good. “{modo}” is still here, whenever you want!

string-array.name: habla_re_respirar_mejor_neutra
string-array.item: Yesterday breathing did you good. “{modo}” is still here.
